newsitem.title: UK: UK ministers meet to discuss manifesto plans.
newsitem.headline: UK ministers meet to discuss manifesto plans.

text.p: Senior cabinet ministers were meeting on Monday morning to discuss key pledges to be put into the Conservative Party's election manifesto, party sources said.
But it was not immediately clear whether any announcement about or hints of the conclusions of the Downing Street get-together would emerge later in the day.

The meeting, one of a series called by Prime Minister John Major ahead of the election, is expected to discuss the idea of a "workfare" scheme for the unemployed, the possibility of privatising London's underground railway system, and whether to shelve plans to scrap the quarantine system for animals imported into Britain.
A spokesman in Major's office stressed no formal meeting of the cabinet has been called for Monday. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
